rules.old: LogPrintf("Failed to open asmap file from disk\n")
rules.replacement: LogInfoEvent(BCLog::ALL, "asmap_file_open_failed", "Failed to open asmap file from disk")

reviewed_input.format: Failed to open asmap file from disk

rules.review_note: Preserve Info level, open/read/parse returns and existing text. ftell length remains signed int (including possible negative values), not coerced into unsigned Bytes. Copy raw asmap version uint256; human path retains exact fs::quoted ampersand/quote escaping via existing :fsq; JSON retains raw filesystem path.

rules.old:
LogPrintf("Opened asmap file %s (%d bytes) from disk\n",
              fs::quoted(fs::PathToString(path)), length)
rules.replacement: LogInfoEvent(BCLog::ALL, "asmap_file_opened", "Opened asmap file {path:fsq} ({asmap_length_bytes} bytes) from disk").Field(BCLog::LogField::Path, fs::PathToString(path)).Field(BCLog::LogField::ASMapLengthBytes, length)

reviewed_input.format: Opened asmap file %s (%d bytes) from disk
